name: Financeit
description: Financeit is a market leading point-of-sale payment plan provider, focused on the home improvement industry, but also with clients in the vehicle and retail industries. Our innovative cloud-based technology makes it easy for merchants to increase close rates and transaction sizes with affordable monthly or bi-weekly payment plans.

jobs.title: Account Manager, British Columbia
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Financeit is a point-of-sale financing provider serving some of the largest home improvement and retail organizations in Canada. Our platform helps businesses close more sales by offering customers affordable monthly payment options for their next big home improvement, vehicle or retail purchase.

We are small enough that you can make an impact within the company and large enough to make an impact in the market. Financeit is a company where collaboration, inclusivity, fairness, and respect aren’t just ideas that get talked about, but are part of who we are. If such a workplace intrigues you, we hope you’ll join us.

About the role:

Reporting into the Sales Director, Western Canada, this B2B role involves building merchant relationships and partnering directly with the owners, finance managers and sales agents. This role will work on the Home Improvement portfolio and support conversations around demo-ing or training for our consumer financing platform. 

The ideal candidate is enthusiastic, a team player with a positive attitude, and is a strong and personable communicator. You are comfortable multi-tasking in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment, while holding yourself accountable for results. You thrive at building meaningful relationships with everyone you interact with.

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) régional(e) des ventes - Québec, T.-N.-L. et Maritimes
jobs.description:
Financeit est un fournisseur de financement au point de vente au service de certaines des plus grandes entreprises de rénovation domiciliaire et de commerce de détail au Canada. Notre plateforme aide les entreprises à conclure plus de ventes en offrant à leurs clients des options de paiements mensuels abordables pour leur prochain grand projet de rénovation, d'achat de véhicule ou de commerce de détail.

Nous sommes une entreprise à taille humaine où vous pouvez avoir un réel impact interne, mais suffisamment grande pour faire la différence sur le marché. Chez Financeit, la collaboration, l'inclusion, l'équité et le respect ne sont pas de simples paroles en l'air, mais font partie intégrante de notre ADN. Si ce milieu de travail vous interpelle, nous espérons que vous vous joindrez à nous.

À propos du rôle :

En mettant l'accent sur la croissance du volume de ventes au Québec, le ou la responsable régional(e) des ventes aura pour mission d'entretenir les comptes existants ainsi que de prospecter et qualifier de nouveaux clients potentiels.

The Sales Specialist (commission only) plays a pivotal role in fostering business connections within our established network of merchants.
